profile.input_policy: Only canonical HTTPS www.douyin.com/user/ID; no query, fragment, short-link expansion or default target

worklist.observer: Public HTTPTransport adapter observes original URLSessionTransport responses; no endpoint or signer reimplementation

pagination.implementation: Original PaginatedCollector updates cursor from RawPage.cursor
pagination.limitation: AccountTimeline drops page metadata; transport observer records it without replacing the collector
pagination.excluded_api: collectAccountBatched synthesizes startCursor + pages and infers hasMore from counts; not acceptable for this test

fields.logging: IDs as strings; descriptions and URLs only as validity/presence flags; no raw payload persisted

download.implementation: Original Downloader buffers HTTP response, writes .part then moves into DownloadLayout
download.eligibility: One video target, explicit status.is_private=0, not deleted/prohibited, HTTPS douyinvod.com or douyin.com and subdomains
download.validation: HTTP 200; no redirects; reject HTML/JSON; size/header/hash/write checks; MP4 ftyp; full AVFoundation video decode
limitations: 100 MiB cap is checked after response buffering, not during transfer
Original downloader accepts arbitrary 2xx bodies and has no decode validation; harness guards are reported as harness checks
Missing public visibility metadata or unsupported host blocks download
No watermark claim without independent evidence

access_policy.cookie: Explicit empty cookie; no inherited DOUYIN_COOKIE
access_policy.signing: Only unchanged original request pipeline if user manually runs; no reverse engineering, patched signatures or identity acquisition
access_policy.stop: 401/403/404/429, redirects, platform errors and possible challenges stop with sanitized reason; no retries or bypass
